name: subaward-monitoring
description: Convert US federal subrecipient reports, award terms and audit findings into a 2 CFR 200.332 monitoring checklist with evidence, owners and corrective actions. Use pasted text or readable exports to review subaward terms, risk factors, financial and performance reports, audit coverage and corrective-action evidence. Build the checklist or follow up audit findings with documented responsibility and deadline bases.
